"''I don't know. It's all new.|Bardi and Rika|}} '''Rika''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] who was a part of the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[4 BBY]], after being stranded on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]], Rika attempted to [[pilot]] a [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]] that was brought to the moon by [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] for the [[Axis network]]. As tensions rose between the rebels, Rika was shot by a frustrated [[Crab (individual)|Crab]], with her body being consumed by a [[Yavinian doodar]].{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Rika was portrayed by [[Eva-Jane Willis]]. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|WUpflQHbJhc|Andor Season 2 | We Ask the Questions | Now Streaming on Disney+}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Rika |ja=リカ（人間） |ka=რიკა (მაია პეის ბრიგადა) }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Members of Maya Pei Brigade]] [[Category:Pilots]]
